deskLvRelayDownText: Payments to you wait. {address} is ready to take over; your address changes with it.

@deskLvRelayDownText.description: Desktop Overview notice at the Shallow level, under the title 'Epicbox server not reachable': the Epicbox server in use has not answered for two minutes and another server, named by its internet address (e.g. epicbox.example.com), was seen working. Switching moves the wallet to that server and gives it a new receiving address. Keep the address as is.
